voyage.name: Triple Bridge
voyage.content: The central span is from 1842: it became a bottleneck so in the 1930s footbridges were added on each side, fanning out slightly. On the north bank these lead into Prešeren Square, adorned by the statue of the national poet France Prešeren (1800-1849). It's the obvious rendezvous point in town; the area is pedestrianised. The TIC is south end of the bridge.

voyage.name: Old Town
voyage.content: The old town has two squares, Mestni trg (City square) with the Robba fountain and the city hall behind it, and, further on, Gornji trg (Upper square). Well preserved medieval buildings now house local designer shops, and several popular cafes and restaurants. Although they may look creepy, the perfectly safe narrow lanes lead to charming little squares and buildings.

voyage.name: Dragon Bridge
voyage.content: Completed in 1901, designed by Croatian Jurij Zainovich. It is guarded by four detailed dragon statues from the city's coat-of-arms. Look out for the dragon motif throughout the city. Be careful around the Dragon Bridge area, as it is on a major busy road just outside the pedestrian zone and near misses (and worse) between inattentive tourists and traffic are common. The dragon bridge is located at the end of the Lju

voyage.name: Ljubljana Castle
voyage.price: Entrance to the Castle Courtyard, Chapel and Gift shop is free, but there is a charge for access to the tower
voyage.content: The tower has magnificent views all over the city. You can also see the Sava River and Kamnik Alps in the distance. Included is a 3D Movie of the history of Ljubljana from a pre-historic settlement to Roman Empire to modern times (€6.50 for adults, €3 for students, seniors).

voyage.name: Republic Square
voyage.content: Where crowds gathered as Slovenia announced its independence from the Yugoslav Federation in 1991. The square has significant importance for Slovene history, as it was a place of important public gatherings (and demonstrations) in the past. Across the road is the Slovene Parliament. Its façade is decorated with artistic nude statues of Slovenes at work and leisure. The square also houses the International Business Ce

voyage.name: Roman Ruins
voyage.content: A short walk west of the centre of town are the remains of the Roman City Walls, including a number of pillars from an entrance gate.

voyage.name: Krakovo
voyage.content: A village-like part of the city connecting the centre to the Trnovo suburb.

voyage.name: Metelkova
voyage.content: A self-declared autonomous culture place to gather for alternative artists, many subcultures and youth. What used to be a military barracks is now full of underground artists, bars and nightclubs. Metelkova can get crowded on Fridays and Saturdays. It is within 5 minute of walk from main Train Station, and it is home to a renowned hostel Celica.

voyage.name: Ljubljana Zoo
voyage.hours: 09:00–16:30 (winter) (open until 19:00 in summer). Closed Christmas Day.
voyage.content: One of the most beautiful zoos in Europe.

voyage.name: University Botanic gardens Ljubljana
voyage.hours: Open daily, Apr–Jun 07–19, Jul–Aug 07–20, Sep–Oct 07–19, Nov–Mar 07–17. Tropical glasshouse has reduced hours: Daily 10:00–16:45
voyage.content: Ljubljana Botanic Garden is the oldest Slovene cultural, scientific and educational institution. It was founded in 1810, the time of the Illyrian Provinces, as a garden of native flora and a section of the Central School (École Centrale). In the garden is also tropical glasshouse.

voyage.name: Tomb of National Heroes
voyage.content: a tomb and a monument for the national heroes of the World War II resistance struggle in Slovenia, created in 1949.

voyage.name: Ursuline Church of the Holy Trinity
voyage.content: A Baroque style church built between 1718 and 1726.

voyage.name: Congress Square
voyage.content: One of the central squares, built in 1821. In 1988 the first free mass demonstration was held here, which was the start of the Slovenian spring, leading to the declaration of Slovenia's independence in 1991.

voyage.name: Nebotičnik
voyage.content: A 13 storey high-rise.built in 1931, designed by Vladimir Šubic, with a cafe & bar on the top floor.

voyage.name: Sts. Cyril and Methodius Church
voyage.content: An Orthodox Church has five domes with golden crosses at their top. It was built from 1932 to 1936, with interior frescos painted between 1986 and 1997.

voyage.name: Franciscan Church of the Annunciation
voyage.content: Built between 1646 and 1660, with a later front facade and bell tower.

voyage.name: Ljubljana Cathedral
voyage.content: St. Nicholas's Church (cerkev sv. Nikolaja) was built between 1701 and 1706 on a site dating back to 1262. The fine interior includes fresco painted by Giulio Quaglio between 1703 and 1723.

voyage.name: Ljubljana Mosque
voyage.hours: For non-muslims - Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu and Sat between 10 and 11 a.m., Exterior is free for all
voyage.content: An intricate set of buildings, the first mosque in the country.

voyage.name: Museum of Architecture and Design
voyage.content: Hosts a permanent exhibition of Jože Plečnik's works.

voyage.name: Plečnik House
voyage.content: Devoted to great Slovenian architect Jože Plečnik, who lived in this building from 1921 to 1957. The house contains rooms with the artist’s valuable original furniture and personal objects, an archive of his sketches and plans and a collection of clay, plaster and wooden models, a library, Plečnik’s correspondence, a photo archive, thesis projects of Plečnik’s students and an archive of the Academy of Architecture Co

voyage.name: Museum of Modern Art
voyage.content: For those who prefer contemporary art, MG+ houses the national collection of 20th-century Slovene art (paintings, sculptures, prints, drawings, photography, video and electronic media collections), a collection of works from the former Yugoslavia, and the Eastern European collection "Arteast 2000+.".

voyage.name: Museum of Contemporary Art
voyage.content: Opened in 2011 in the former military barracks complex this is complementary museum to the MG+. Opening hours and prices same as +MG. Adult combined tickets available.

voyage.name: National Gallery
voyage.price: Permanent Exhibitions Adults €8 Concessions €6. see website for others.
voyage.content: Definitely worth visiting if you care about art. It exhibits two important permanent collections that include works of some of the best and most renowned Slovenian (impressionist) painters (Jama, Grohar, Jakopic, Azbe). You can also see there a restored original of the Robba Fountain, a monument of national cultural heritage.

voyage.name: National Museum of Slovenia - Prešernova
voyage.price: Free admission each first Sunday of the month
voyage.hours: daily 10:00-18:00, Thu 10:00-20:00, closed on public holidays.
voyage.content: The oldest and the largest Slovene museum. It was founded in 1821. Existent museum building on the Museum street, was built in 1888 and was the first, building, assigned solely to culture in Slovenia. Today its stores a rich collections of valuable objects. The oldest spring back to the Stone Age, but there are also the newer ones, which are still used in our everyday life. Important columns of museum activity are al

voyage.name: National Museum of Slovenia - Metelkova
voyage.content: In the new building of the National museum of Slovenia on the Metelkova Street, are exhibited collections of the applied art heritage of Slovenia. The permanent exhibition brings together objects of applied arts from the 14th century to the present day.

voyage.name: National Museum of Contemporary History
voyage.content: Slovenia's 20th-century history museum gives you a real sense of the country's roller-coaster ride through regime after regime. Its immersive exhibits include a walk-through World War I trench. The last exhibit shows the events around the Declaration of Independence from Yugoslavia and the Ten Day War with the Yugoslav Federal Army. All exhibits are translated to English and some to German too.

voyage.name: Slovenian Museum of Natural History
voyage.content: Features an almost complete skeleton of a 20,000 year old mammoth found near Kamnik in 1938, a 200-million-year old fossil fish skeleton found in Triglav National Park, and a new, 13-m skeleton of a fin whale. Also has a large mineral collection.

voyage.name: MGLC International Centre of Graphic Arts
voyage.content: Specialised in art shows, often in collaboration with international institutions. Normally on nearby sites but MGLC Tivoli Mansion is closed for renovation.

voyage.name: City Museum of Ljubljana
voyage.content: City history and temporary exhibitions.

voyage.name: Railway Museum
voyage.price: Adults €8 Children, students, pensioners €4 group & family prices available
voyage.content: Covers all aspects of the railway, Great selection of steam locos.

voyage.name: House of experiments
voyage.content: A hands-on science "playground" for kids.

voyage.name: Hot Air Balloon Flights
voyage.content: These launch at sunrise for one-hour flights, weather permitting. The launch spot is chosen on the day so the wind carries you over the historic centre. The whole programme is about 4 hours so reckon on a very early start.

voyage.name: Olimpija Ljubljana
voyage.content: They play soccer in PrvaLiga, the top tier. Their home ground (capacity 16,000) is off the ring road 2 km north of city centre.

voyage.name: Water City of Atlantis
voyage.content: A water park offering 14 pools, thermal baths, slides and saunas. Special section is dedicated for children.

voyage.name: Laguna Fun & Spa
voyage.content: Offers open-air pools during the day and themed parties at night.

voyage.name: Cankarjev Dom
voyage.content: Enormous arts and convention centre with concerts and performances.

voyage.name: Slovenian Philharmonic Orchestra
voyage.content: Orchestra dating back to 1701.

voyage.name: Križanke Outdoor Theatre
voyage.content: used for summer festivals.

voyage.name: Ljubljana Summer Festival
voyage.content: Opera, ballet and theatre festival held in July and August.

voyage.name: Kinoteka
voyage.hours: Open daily, but closed on Sundays and in July and August
voyage.content: Ljubljana's charming film museum where they have at least two movies a day. The movies range from classics to cult movies, from trash and horror to artistic masterpieces. All movies are presented in the original audio language, and equipped with Slovenian subtitles, sometimes also English. On Saturday mornings they have special projections for children. There are also some special events, round tables, premiers etc.

voyage.name: Kinodvor
voyage.content: This is a small and very cool cinema that shows mostly new movies that are not playing in the blockbuster movie complexes. It has also a lot of special events, a great cafe and movies for children (Sundays).

voyage.name: Arena Play & Party
voyage.content: A great place to spend an evening. Main features include bowling, pool, laser games and a state-of-the-art 3D XpanD cinema theatre.

voyage.name: Cineplexx
voyage.content: A Multiplex.

voyage.name: HourAway
voyage.content: Houraway offers high-quality bike rentals, including e-bikes, road bikes, and gravel bikes, along with guided and self-guided cycling tours. Their expertly designed day and multi-day tours cater to all fitness levels, showcasing Slovenia’s scenic landscapes, from peaceful countryside paths to challenging mountain routes.

voyage.name: BTC City Shopping District
voyage.content: One of Ljubljana's two main shopping area.

voyage.name: Rudnik Shopping District
voyage.content: The second major shopping district.

voyage.name: Sunday flea market
voyage.content: Two dozen or so stalls selling overpriced knick-knacks. Postcards, €10. Tito and Disney memorabilia, broken Chinese-made curios, rusty military paraphernalia.

voyage.name: Central Market
voyage.content: The central, open-air market features a wide array of local produce (exact items vary depending on the season), as well as local cheeses, breads and meats in the adjacent building. If you're lucky, you may still find sellers who have wheeled in their vegetables from south of the city centre (Krakovo) by foot—although they are a dying breed. Open every morning and early afternoon except Sunday; most lively on Saturday

voyage.name: Odprta Kuhna
voyage.content: Odprta Kuhna means "open kitchen". It's a collection of food stalls on Pogačarjev trg, just south of Triple Bridge.

voyage.name: Hot Horse
voyage.address: BTC City, Šmartinska 152; Tivoli Park, Celovška 25
voyage.content: Horse-burger chain with four city outlets. Huge burgers and other dishes; you order and pay first at the machine.

voyage.name: Nobel Burek
voyage.content: Open non-stop, so it's popular late at night. Different kinds of burek (a leafy dough pie filled with mince meat or cheese).

voyage.name: Klobasarna
voyage.content: Hole-in-the-wall fast food restaurant serving seasonal Slovenian soups with traditional sausages and bread. You order and pay first at the machine.

voyage.name: Govinda's
voyage.content: Self-service buffet with vegetarian and vegan Indian food, great value.

voyage.name: Cafe Capri
voyage.content: A cozy cafe in the very center of Ljubljana, just a few steps away from the famous Dragon Bridge, offers healthy, delicious and inexpensive breakfasts and brunches. All dishes here are made from scratch and prepared fresh. Full bar always available with variety of any drinks: fragrant coffee, tea, fresh squeezed juices and homemade lemonades, Italian and Slovenian wines, beer, spirits and cocktails.

voyage.name: Restavracija Mandala
voyage.address: Podhod Ajdovščina. close to bus stop Ajdovščina
voyage.content: Vegan self-service restaurant. Food sold by weight.

voyage.name: Falafel
voyage.content: The name is a clue. They also offer mezze dishes.

voyage.name: Roza Slon
voyage.content: Restaurant/takeaway offering tasty & healthy Thai meals with a choice of beers & soft drinks. they are also at a few other locations in the city. Some vegan options.

voyage.name: Gostilna Portal
voyage.content: This is a B&B in the eastern burbs, known as a Serbian restaurant - good for meat lovers. Loud live music at weekends.

voyage.name: Da-bu-da
voyage.content: Thai food and cocktail bar, great atmosphere.

voyage.name: Figovec
voyage.content: Popular place serving pony steaks, horse goulash, and traditional Slovenian food.

voyage.name: Foculus
voyage.content: Flamboyantly decorated pizzeria and salad restaurant.

voyage.name: Čad
voyage.content: Specialises in grilled dishes from the Balkans; good value.

voyage.name: Gostilna Sokol
voyage.content: Authentic Slovenian cuisine, with serving staff got up in traditional costume. So inevitably it's touristy, but good food in huge portions and very good value for money.

voyage.name: Joe Pena's Cantina
voyage.content: Popular Mexican restaurant.

voyage.name: Julija
voyage.content: Filling fare of Italian pasta and risotto dishes.

voyage.name: Cafe Romeo
voyage.content: Riverside cafe, the pancakes are their specialty.

voyage.name: Jurman
voyage.content: Family-friendly reliable comfort-food place in the burbs.

voyage.name: Ljubljanski Dvor
voyage.content: Pizzeria with nice patio overlooking the river, the quality of food is uneven.

voyage.name: Pri Škofu
voyage.content: Mostly trad and Med fare, with vegetarian options.

voyage.name: Šestica
voyage.content: Serves hearty meat dishes such as sausages, horse fillets, and steak as well as pasta and risotto.

voyage.name: Špajza
voyage.content: It's larger than it looks from the street, with several candlelit rooms leading to the outside terrace. Trad cuisine, good reviews for quality and service.

voyage.name: Zhong Hua
voyage.content: Decent Chinese restaurant near Dragon Bridge.

voyage.name: Gostilna Pod Vrbo
voyage.content: Huge range of Slovenian fare, generous portions.

voyage.name: AS Aperitivo
voyage.content: Trendy spot with two areas, for casual dining or the restaurant. Mostly positive reviews.

voyage.name: Cubo
voyage.content: Med cuisine, earns consistent good reviews.

voyage.name: JB
voyage.content: Modern international fare, pricey by local standards, and mixed reviews on food quality.

voyage.name: Krpan
voyage.content: Good seafood restaurant.

voyage.name: Manna
voyage.content: Excellent traditional dishes with slick friendly service.

voyage.name: Strelec
voyage.content: This is within Archer's Tower of the castle, with a terrace overlooking the city. So you're paying for the great location but the food also scores.

voyage.name: Gaudi&Naan
voyage.address: Trubarjeva cesta 7 vhod iz Malega trga
voyage.content: Fine quality vegan restaurant

voyage.name: Cafe Antico
voyage.content: Great ambiance - bare wooden floors, high tables and stools, and vaulted ceiling.

voyage.name: Čajna Hiša
voyage.content: This is a quirky little coffee and tea room, offering many variations on those warm beverages as well as basic breakfasts and lunches. The background music is impeccably cool, and the atmosphere is ideal for some elegant loafing. Linked to the café is a teashop selling drinking paraphernalia and loads of different fruity flavoured teas by the 100g.

voyage.name: Le Petit Cafe
voyage.content: Very popular corner cafe.

voyage.name: Sax Hostel & Sax pub
voyage.content: Really cool colourful spray-painted cafe/bar along the canal. The place also serves as a hostel.

voyage.name: Zvezda
voyage.content: Cafe with great ices and pastries.

voyage.name: Cutty Sark
voyage.content: Lively pub with raucous atmosphere. Usually has live music.

voyage.name: Lepa Žoga
voyage.content: Main sports cafe/bar with sports regalia along the wall and a good, mixed crowd on most nights. Shows international rugby, all sorts of football games (European, English, Italian and other leagues) and other live sports. Has the best TV coverage in the city, ranging from Sky Sports to local TV stations.

voyage.name: Od Žmavca sosed pa ud brata prjatu
voyage.alt: Žmavc's neighbor and my brother's pal aka Žmavc
voyage.content: Markets to the "creative urban type." Burgers, coffee and alcoholic drinks.

voyage.name: Pod Skalco
voyage.content: Popular student pub with an almost 150-year-long tradition, frequented almost exclusively by locals. Loud music.

voyage.name: Vinoteka Movia
voyage.content: Anyone with any interest in wine should visit here. The cosy, candlelit wine bar comes with knowledgeable barmen who can recommend a wine based on your tastes. The wine glasses are huge, so it's hard to tell if they were being stingy or if it has simply spread out. Be careful about asking for ‘samples’, as they will charge you full price. The prices can vary from modest to a remortgage.

voyage.name: Sir William's pub
voyage.content: Located in the Art Nouveau part of Ljubljana city centre, offers more than 120 beer varieties and a large choice of teas and wines. It is vibrant in the evenings, particularly when it hosts themed events and beer tastings, while during the day it has a more coffee house-like atmosphere, offering its guests an opportunity to browse through a newspaper or read a book in peace. The staff speak several languages. Free wi

voyage.name: Lajbah
voyage.content: Beer hall with outdoor area. Large choice of craft beers & mainly Asian food.

voyage.name: Tozd
voyage.content: Bar with coffee & craft beers

voyage.name: Tektonix Craft Brewery
voyage.content: Microbrewery & bar close to railway station. Brewery tours available.

voyage.name: Union Pub
voyage.content: Pub at the Union brewery. food available. This is the opposite of a micro brewery.

voyage.name: Gas Station
voyage.content: Popular quirky bar with a 1961 Chrysler Newport as part of the seating.

voyage.name: Metelkova mesto
voyage.content: It's a squat with 6 clubs, each with its own style of music and programme. Gala Hala is the biggest and the music is very diverse - from funk nights to hip-hop and indie to rap and strange fun music. It has also concerts and an outside garden where they also grill in the summer. Gromka is a smaller one usually admission free and the music also differs from night to night. Usually it's rock/alternative hits or rockabi

voyage.name: K4
voyage.content: National and international DJs play electronic music.

voyage.name: Aladin Hostel
voyage.content: Small friendly hostel.

voyage.name: Celica
voyage.content: This was the military brig, get caught in town without a pass and The Cells was where you'd spend the night. Then they got the designers in, how come Guantanamo never cottoned on to this concept? Good to know: each cell was individually designed by a Slovenian artist.

voyage.name: Hostel Tabor
voyage.content: Clean friendly place in student residence, only open July and Aug. In 2023 the dorm is not available.

voyage.name: Fluxus Hostel
voyage.content: Small clean central place with 8- and 6-bed dorm.

voyage.name: Most Hostel
voyage.content: Cute friendly hostel, very central.

voyage.name: Vila Veselova
voyage.content: Budget / hostel rooms in a 100-year-old villa west side of town.

voyage.name: The Fuzzy Log
voyage.content: Unusual hostel on 7th floor of Ibis Styles hotel. featuring tents, cabins, and capsules. Buffet breakfast available.

voyage.name: BIT Center Hotel
voyage.content: Basic functional place which also contains a hostel.

voyage.name: City Hotel
voyage.content: Decent central place with clean rooms, thin walls.

voyage.name: Hotel Park
voyage.content: Clean central mid to budget hotel with 145 rooms. They formerly also offered "hostel" rooms, cheaper but bare; these are not on offer in 2021.

voyage.name: Hotel Katrca 1905
voyage.content: Pleasant place in a quiet district, has only five rooms.

voyage.name: M Hotel
voyage.content: Boxy modern place 2 km northwest of centre with neat, spacious rooms.

voyage.name: Pension Tavcar
voyage.content: Clean well-run place northeast edge of city.

voyage.name: Hotel Mrak
voyage.content: Colourful rooms, nice restaurant, and great central location. Doesn't have a parking lot so you'd pay pricey central parking rates.

voyage.name: Austria Trend Hotel
voyage.content: Modern slab with 214 rooms, spacious and good sound-proofing. All rooms have air-con, safe, minibar, hair dryer, flat screen, satellite TV and radio.

voyage.name: Best Western Premier Hotel Slon
voyage.content: Modern chain hotel with clean and comfy rooms. Their website is uninformative about pets, but it's said that in 1552 Archduke Maximilian stayed at an inn on this spot in the company of an elephant.

voyage.name: Grand Hotel Union
voyage.content: Splendid Art Nouveau building. Large comfy rooms though showing their age, some have views of the castle. Restaurant, fitness centre, sauna, and rooftop pool.

voyage.name: Hotel Lev
voyage.content: Glassy high rise building, smart and comfy. In 2020 / 21 it was mothballed and guests were shifted elsewhere - "re-protected" is their splendidly unctuous euphemism for this.

voyage.name: Central Hotel
voyage.content: Central boxy modern hotel, comfy and brightly decorated. Reception is on the 7th floor: it's a "concept" apparently.

voyage.name: Four Points by Sheraton
voyage.content: 4-star business hotel by the forest west edge of town, convenient for motorists. With spa and fitness centre.

voyage.name: Ljubljana Resort
voyage.content: Camping and tourer caravan site edge of town by River Sava. Also has rooms for B&B plus swimming pool, sauna, fitness centre, badminton, volleyball, bowling, play area and restaurant.

voyage.name: Hotel Grandvid
voyage.content: Clean modern place with restaurant, on bus route to city.

voyage.name: Kongo Hotel & Casino
voyage.content: 4-star hotel handy for motorists and business travellers. Comfy rooms, restaurant, and of course the casino.
